record.title: Electric Storage Water Heaters - Domestic Safety and Energy Performance
record.description:
Specifies electrical safety, thermal performance, pressure containment, controls, energy-performance declaration, and marking requirements for domestic electric storage water heaters.

Applies to fixed electric storage water heaters for domestic hot-water service within the declared capacity range; excludes instantaneous heaters and industrial hot-water vessels.

Key requirements: Tank and pressure-containing parts shall withstand the specified pressure condition.; Electrical protection shall address insulation, leakage, and protective-device operation.; Thermostatic controls shall maintain the declared water-temperature range.; Energy-performance information shall be supported by the stated test method.

Testing requirements: Pressure containment and leakage test.; Dielectric strength and insulation tests.; Thermostat and safety cut-out function test.; Energy-performance or heat-loss verification.

Documentation required: Tank construction specification.; Electrical schematic and component list.; Installation and operating manual.; Laboratory safety and energy-performance evidence.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer identification.; Rated capacity and electrical data.; Model and serial/batch identification.; Installation warnings and pressure-related information.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where a relevant product control order adopts this standard; otherwise conformity assessment may be voluntary or procurement-driven.
